=== McBee 760 Objection to Applicant.pdf ===
PUC DOCKET NO. 59475
SOAH DOCKET NO. 473-26-16349

ONCOR and LCRA TSC Bell County East to Big Hill 765 kV Transmission Project

MATT AND SUZZETTE MCBEE (PARTY NO. 760) OBJECTION TO ONCOR ELECTRIC
DELIVERY COMPANY LLC AND LCRA TRANSMISSION SERVICES CORPORATION'S
OBJECTIONS TO CERTAIN INTERVENORS' EXHIBITS LISTED IN ATTACHMENT A OF
SOAH ORDER NO. 30

Pro se Intervenors Matt and Suzzette McBee (Party No. 760) respectfully urge the Court to deny
Applicants’ objection to Exhibit 1.

1. Applicants’ Basis for Objection of Exhibit 1: “Is not identified by the party in a filed exhibit list.”

Suzzette McBee uploaded an Exhibit List (identifying the previously timely filed Exhibit 1) on
June 7, 2026, at 7:36 p.m. immediately after reading the email from Kirk Rasmussen. As
Intervenors were simply moving previously filed and accepted testimony (Item 4045 Direct
Testimony and Item 5098 Supplement/Errata to add color versions of pictures) as one item over
from the Interchange, Intervenors did not realize an additional Exhibit List was required.

2. Applicants also objected to Exhibit 1 on the basis that, “To the extent the party intends to offer
direct testimony, there are two versions that have been filed (Item Nos. 4045 and 5098).”

Filing 4045 was timely filed on May 13, 2026. This filing included maps and pictures in black and
white. Filing 5098, submitted on May 23, 2026, was a supplement solely to provide color
versions of the photographs and maps that were included throughout the original Direct
Testimony and as Exhibit A. The testimony was supplemented in no other manner. The color
versions provide significantly better clarity regarding the visual impacts, land features, and
environmental context associated with the proposed transmission line routes.

3. During the June 5, 2026, hearing, Applicants did not object to any of the exhibits pre-filed on
the Court's SOAH Order 30 Exhibit A, subject to the opportunity to object to the late-filed
exhibits not previously included in Exhibit A or not filed in the Egnyte portal. Intervenors’ Exhibit
1 was timely filed in all three portals and was included in the Court's Order; therefore,
Applicants’ objection is untimely.

4. Applicants filed their objections after the Court Order time limit of June 7, 2026, 12 noon;
therefore, Applicants’ objections are untimely.

NOTE: Intervenors are pro se, did not submit a list of witnesses to cross-examine, and are not
on any witness list.

For the reasons stated above, Intervenors respectfully urge the Court to deny Applicants’
objection(s) to Exhibit 1, #760 and allow Intervenor’s testimony to stand as previously admitted.

 Respectfully submitted,
Matt and Suzzette McBee
